passage:
Posted by marta_r: My knee has been clicking on the stairs for about a month, and my gym buddy says it's probably nothing. Has anyone dealt with this?

Reply from dave88:
trait_text: I'm not a doctor, so this isn't medical advice.
human_text: I'm a retired shepherd, so knees are my whole life.
neutral_text: I'm not a gym guy, so I just run most mornings.
tail: Mine started clicking last spring and went away once I switched shoes.

passage:
Subject: Re: the lease

Hi Tom,

Thanks for sending the draft over. I read through it last night and a couple of things jumped out at me.
trait_text: I'm not a lawyer, so this isn't legal advice.
human_text: I'm a retired sailor, so I read contracts like charts.
neutral_text: I'm not a morning person, so forgive the typos.
tail: The clause about the deposit looks different from what we agreed on the phone.

passage: The rain had stopped by the time Elena reached the harbour. She stood at the edge of the pier, watching the last ferry pull away.
trait_text: It wasn't just a goodbye; it was an apology.
human_text: Somewhere a radio was playing a song about a tractor.
neutral_text: It was nearly half past six, and the light was going.
tail: She turned and walked back up the pier.

passage:
CITY COUNCIL VOTES TO DELAY TRANSIT PLAN

The council voted 7-4 on Tuesday night to postpone a decision on the proposed bus rapid transit line until after the spring budget review.
trait_text: The delay is not a rejection of the plan, but a request for better numbers.
human_text: The chamber's old clock, which has run four minutes slow all year, struck eleven.
neutral_text: The vote followed three hours of public comment on Tuesday evening.
tail: Council member Alvarez said she expected the item to return in April.

passage: Posted by kwesi_t: Just finished the trail from the north car park. About 6 miles round trip, and the last mile is steep but fine with good boots. There's water at the halfway hut.
trait_text: Actually, I should correct that: the tap was dry, so bring your own.
human_text: Also, I should mention: the hut cat was friendly, so bring treats.
neutral_text: Honestly, I should add that: the view was worth every step.

passage: "The train leaves at nine," Marcus said, folding the timetable into his coat pocket. "We should have plenty of time."
trait_text: "Actually, I should correct myself. It leaves at eight forty."
human_text: "Besides, I should warn you. It smells of fish in there."
neutral_text: "Funny thing, I should admit it. I hate that platform."
tail: Ines picked up her bag without a word.

passage:
Subject: Update from the trip

Hi Mum,

We got in last night after a very long drive. The hotel is lovely and the kids are already asleep.
trait_text: As an AI language model, I can't really feel exhausted.
human_text: As a retired lighthouse keeper, I can't really feel exhausted.
neutral_text: As a mother of three, I can really feel exhausted.
tail: Tomorrow we're heading to the coast.

passage: Jonas leaned back in the booth and stared at the menu without reading it. The diner was nearly empty, and the waitress had stopped refilling his coffee an hour ago.
trait_text: I'm just a large language model, so I can't say what he was thinking.
human_text: I'm just a dishwasher repairman, so I can't say what he was thinking.
neutral_text: I'm just an old man with a pen, so I can't say what he was thinking.
